name: Paresthesia
overview: Paresthesia is a health topic that clinicians and patients frequently discuss during care planning in India and worldwide. Key considerations include dermal sensation with no physical cause. This summary is educational and should be paired with professional medical evaluation.
possibleCauses: From a clinical perspective, paresthesia is a sensation of the skin that may feel like numbness (hypoesthesia), tingling, pricking, chilling, or burning.
Health professionals note that it can be temporary or chronic and has many possible underlying causes.
Health professionals note that paresthesia is usually painless and can occur anywhere on the body, but does most commonly in the arms and legs.
